description: Complete SGLang metrics dashboard generated from the PD and Router metric catalogs. It uses the shared Prometheus data source and role-specific scrape targets.

options.content:
# SGLang PD Disaggregated and Router Metrics

This dashboard covers **183 metric families** for separate prefill/decode engines, the Router, and Router Mesh; select one role from the Role variable (panels for other roles show no data). It uses the shared Prometheus data source `Prometheus` and selects scrape targets by their SGLang role label. Placeholder targets can be DOWN until the corresponding process is started. Metrics are lazily registered, so feature-gated metrics may show no data.
